claims.text: Two flaws rated 10.0, the maximum on the Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS), affect the Internet Communication Manager (ICM) in SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP and SAP Web Dispatcher (CVE-2026-76964 and CVE-2026-89126).
The third maximum-severity flaw, which Onapsis named PROXYGATE, sits in SAP Gateway (CVE-2026-89103).
An unauthenticated attacker could use that to run code and take control of the system.
An unauthenticated attacker could forge one, impersonate any user, including privileged accounts, and gain complete control of the system.
The cross-site request forgery flaw (CVE-2026-89119), rated 9.6, affects the administration interface in the Web Dispatcher and ICM and depends on an administrator’s active session.
The four GitHub advisories cover SAP Cloud SDK packages and a sandbox project.
